Participants, procedure and measures
Players choose a number from 0 to 100 simultaneously. The winner is closest to the group mean multiplied by the announced factor. Sessions use 1/2, 2/3 or 4/3. The same group plays four rounds and sees all anonymous guesses, the mean, the target and the winning number after each round.
